name: site.goat-lighthouse/market-news
title: Market News API
description: AI-scored market news, $0.10 batch & 1,423d archive via x402 USDC on Base/Solana (15 MCP tools)

tools.name: market_catalogue
tools.description: Discover the service: returns routes, prices and networks, plus available_days (completed news days on sale), announcement_years and feed freshness (coverage.as_of, rows). Use it to choose a tool and valid date or year inputs, not to fetch records. Free, no account or API key.

tools.name: news_sample
tools.description: Omit view for one historical scored record. Set view to delayed for up to 20 market headlines first seen at least 30 minutes ago, with publisher and capture times. The delayed preview omits scores. Both views are free.

view.description: Choose the historical scored example or the latest delayed preview.

tools.name: list_supported_coins
tools.description: Find valid filters before a coin request: returns tracked market coins with symbol and rank, plus recent news ticker counts. News tickers may be stocks or forex. Free, no account or API key.

tools.name: check_pass
tools.description: Use after buy_week_pass or buy_month_pass to check a pass key: returns status active, expired, revoked or invalid, with the plan and expiry for a genuine key. Grants no data. Free, no payment; the key is not logged.

key.description: The pass key returned by buy_week_pass or buy_month_pass; it starts with n402p_.

tools.name: get_latest_news
tools.description: Use for the last 48 hours across all markets: stocks, forex, commodities, macro and crypto. For crypto-only headlines use get_crypto_news; for a past day use get_news_day. Recent crypto, stock, forex and macro headlines with publisher, times, labels and AI scores where available: returns a JSON object with count and items, or stored label counts with format=sentiment_summary. Call without payment to see the price and matching count; pay to get the records. Parameters combine as filters: limit: 1-100, default 50; coin: optional case-insensitive ticker; call list_supported_coins or GET /v1/coins for recent labels; market: optional lower-case market label; tag: optional lower-case label; relevant: optional true; sentiment: optional positive, neutral, negative or unscored stored label; missing labels do not match; q: optional keyword search in headline titles, 2-60 characters; since: optional UTC timestamp ending Z; before: optional next_before cursor for the next older page; stable: true pins pages to the first feed revision for at most three hours; restart if unavailable; format: compact, sentiment_summary, or omit for full fields. Costs $0.005 USDC via x402; without payment returns an offer. No account or API key required. USDC on Base or Solana. Invalid, empty or stale requests are refused before payment. Retrying the same payment reuses a remembered settlement when its record is available; availability is not guaranteed.

limit.description: Maximum records to return, 1 to 100. Default 50.

coin.description: Optional ticker such as BTC, ETH, NVDA or EURUSD, matched against the AI-tagged coins and the tickers named in each record. Call list_supported_coins or GET /v1/coins for recent labels.

market.description: Optional market label: crypto, equities, forex, commodities, rates, macro, energy or real_estate.

tag.description: Optional label to match, lower case: a ticker (btc, nvda, eurusd, xau), a topic or an event type (token_listing, etf_approval).

relevant.description: Optional: true keeps only market-relevant records: a market, ticker, crypto asset, exchange or event label, a Binance announcement, or an AI score away from neutral (positive or negative). Drops general news such as sport and politics without market content.

q.description: Optional keyword or phrase, 2 to 60 characters, matched case-insensitively in the headline title, such as ETF or rate cut. A paid request with no matching headline is refused before any charge.

since.description: Optional UTC time such as 2026-11-13T09:00:00Z: only records first seen after it, so a bot polling every hour pays for new items only.

before.description: Optional page cursor: pass next_before from the previous response to get the next older page of the same query. A response carries next_before while older matching records remain.

stable.description: Opt in to a snapshot-bound cursor; keep the same selection and stable=true. Expired or unavailable snapshots require a fresh first page before payment.

format.description: Optional compact fields or sentiment_summary counts for the selected page. Summary counts stored labels and finite numeric scores without returning records. Omit for the full response.

sentiment.description: Optional stored sentiment label: positive, neutral, negative or unscored. Records without a stored label do not match, including unscored.

first_in_group.description: Optional true: keep records explicitly marked repeat_first=true. Missing flags are excluded; groups are source-defined and do not guarantee unique real-world events. Omit to retain all observations.

tools.name: get_market_signal_batch
tools.description: Use when an agent needs a cross-market snapshot in one $0.10 USDC call: grouped headlines across up to 8 markets, optional per-coin slices (up to 10 tickers), recent Binance listing alerts, and tracked coin prices. A grouped multi-market signal brief (crypto, stocks, forex, commodities, macro), optional per-coin slices, recent Binance listing alerts and tracked coin snapshot: returns a JSON object with count and items. Call without payment to see the price and matching count; pay to get the records. Parameters combine as filters: markets: optional 1-8 comma-separated market labels; coins: optional 1-10 comma-separated tickers; limit_per_slice: 1-25 per slice, default 10; relevant: optional true; since: optional UTC timestamp ending Z; format: compact or omit for full fields. Costs $0.1 USDC via x402; without payment returns an offer. No account or API key required. USDC on Base or Solana. Invalid, empty or stale requests are refused before payment. Retrying the same payment reuses a remembered settlement when its record is available; availability is not guaranteed.

markets.description: Optional comma-separated market labels (1 to 8 from crypto, equities, forex, commodities, rates, macro, energy, real_estate). Default crypto,equities,forex,commodities,macro.

coins.description: Optional comma-separated tickers (1 to 10, e.g. BTC,ETH,SOL,DOGE,XRP) for per-coin headline slices alongside the market buckets.

limit_per_slice.description: Maximum headlines returned per market, coin or listings slice, 1 to 25. Default 10.

relevant.description: Optional: true keeps only market-relevant records: a market, ticker, crypto asset, exchange or event label, a Binance announcement, or an AI score away from neutral (positive or negative). Drops general news such as sport and politics without market content.

first_in_group.description: Optional true: keep records explicitly marked repeat_first=true. Missing flags are excluded; groups are source-defined and do not guarantee unique real-world events. Omit to retain all observations.

since.description: Optional UTC time such as 2026-11-13T09:00:00Z: only records first seen after it, so a bot polling every hour pays for new items only.

format.description: Optional compact view: retain selected headline or market fields and omit other fields. Omit for the full response.

Historical scores are retrospective. One stored UTC day of market headlines and exchange announcements, with timestamps and retrospective scores: returns a JSON object with count and items. Call without payment to see the price and matching count; pay to get the records. Parameters combine as filters: date: required completed UTC day YYYY-MM-DD; market_catalogue.available_days lists available days; market: optional lower-case market label; tag: optional lower-case label; relevant: optional true; sentiment: optional positive, neutral, negative or unscored stored label; missing labels do not match; q: optional keyword search in headline titles, 2-60 characters. Costs $0.05 USDC via x402; without payment returns an offer. No account or API key required. USDC on Base or Solana. Invalid, empty or stale requests are refused before payment. Retrying the same payment reuses a remembered settlement when its record is available; availability is not guaranteed. Optional format=sentiment_summary returns stored label counts and the numeric score count instead of records.

tools.description: Use for the latest tracked coin prices, market caps and 24-hour volume; returns no news. Call list_supported_coins for the tracked coins. A snapshot batch of all tracked coins with prices, market caps, volume and rank where available: returns a JSON object with count and items. Call without payment to see the price and matching count; pay to get the records. Parameters combine as filters: coin: optional case-insensitive tracked ticker; call list_supported_coins or GET /v1/coins; format: compact or omit for full fields. Costs $0.005 USDC via x402; without payment returns an offer. No account or API key required. USDC on Base or Solana. Invalid, empty or stale requests are refused before payment. Retrying the same payment reuses a remembered settlement when its record is available; availability is not guaranteed.

coin.description: Optional tracked coin symbol such as BTC, ETH or DOGE; leave it out to get every tracked coin. Only tracked coins are accepted; call list_supported_coins or GET /v1/coins.

format.description: Optional compact view: retain selected headline or market fields and omit other fields. Omit for the full response.

tools.name: get_listing_events
tools.description: Use for Binance listing and delisting events from the last 48 hours only. For all Binance announcements use get_latest_announcements. Binance listing and delisting events from the last 48 hours, newest first: token listings, trading pairs, futures launches, delistings, pair removals and collateral eligibility. Includes pairs, announcement and capture times, and AI crypto-impact scores where available. In full or compact, event_types uses trading_pair_added for a new pair and collateral_eligibility for eligible collateral. Filter by coin.: returns a JSON object with count and items. Call without payment to see the price and matching count; pay to get the records. Parameters combine as filters: limit: 1-100, default 50; coin: optional case-insensitive ticker; call list_supported_coins or GET /v1/coins for recent labels; q: optional keyword search in headline titles, 2-60 characters; since: optional UTC timestamp ending Z; before: optional next_before cursor for the next older page; format: compact or omit for full fields. Costs $0.01 USDC via x402; without payment returns an offer. No account or API key required. USDC on Base or Solana. Invalid, empty or stale requests are refused before payment. Retrying the same payment reuses a remembered settlement when its record is available; availability is not guaranteed.

tools.name: get_announcement_history
tools.description: Use for one calendar year of Binance announcements. For the last 48 hours use get_latest_announcements. One year of exchange announcements with categories, trading pairs and timestamps: returns a JSON object with count and items. Call without payment to see the price and matching count; pay to get the records. Parameters combine as filters: year: required YYYY from 2017; market_catalogue.announcement_years lists available years; coin: optional case-insensitive ticker; call list_supported_coins or GET /v1/coins for recent labels; event: optional listings or delistings. Costs $0.25 USDC via x402; without payment returns an offer. No account or API key required. USDC on Base or Solana. Invalid, empty or stale requests are refused before payment. Retrying the same payment reuses a remembered settlement when its record is available; availability is not guaranteed.

year.description: A calendar year from 2017, YYYY. The free market_catalogue tool lists the years on sale in announcement_years (also GET /health).

event.description: Optional: listings keeps new tokens, new trading pairs and futures launches; delistings keeps token delistings and trading pair removals.

coin.description: Optional ticker such as BTC, ETH, NVDA or EURUSD, matched against the AI-tagged coins and the tickers named in each record. Call list_supported_coins or GET /v1/coins for recent labels.

tools.name: buy_week_pass
tools.description: Use when you will call the data routes often for up to seven days. For thirty days use buy_month_pass; for a single call, call the data tool directly. Check a key's expiry with check_pass. A seven-day fair-use access pass: returns a news402 pass key and expiry for the eight data routes. Send the pass key as a Bearer token. Fair use applies. Call without payment to see the offer; pay to get the news402 pass key. No parameters. Costs $3 USDC via x402; without payment returns an offer. No account or API key required. USDC on Base or Solana. Retrying the same payment reuses a remembered settlement when its record is available; availability is not guaranteed.

tools.name: buy_month_pass
tools.description: Use when you will call the data routes often for up to thirty days. For seven days use buy_week_pass; for a single call, call the data tool directly. Check a key's expiry with check_pass. A thirty-day fair-use access pass: returns a news402 pass key and expiry for the eight data routes. Send the pass key as a Bearer token. Fair use applies. Call without payment to see the offer; pay to get the news402 pass key. No parameters. Costs $9 USDC via x402; without payment returns an offer. No account or API key required. USDC on Base or Solana. Retrying the same payment reuses a remembered settlement when its record is available; availability is not guaranteed.
